title: The Clarke-Boland big band
summary: Working with the Clarke-Boland band alongside Benny Bailey, Sahib Shihab and Johnny Griffin, compared with the Austrian band's background music.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: During this time, you were working with the Clarke-Boland big band?
Yes, working with Clarke-Boland’s band and something other things too.
That reunited you with a lot of folks that you had known in New York.

Yeah, ‘cause Kenny Clarke and I were always friendly here. He used to play with me on records and at Birdland. The Clarke-Boland band was a great swinging band. Benny Bailey, who is a great trumpet player, was there, Sahib Shihab. A very great Swedish trombone player named Ake Persson was there. Johnny Griffin was there. You know, the cats.
Must have been kind of a study in contrast to go from playing with the Austrian band to go and play with…
The Austrian band was cool. What really was the bad side of it was we wound up playing not jazz but background music for singers and any silly thing that they felt that the people wanted to hear.
